entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect a further 80 to 120 mm of rain on top of what has already fallen. Peak rates of 15 to 20 mm/h expected until early Monday morning. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.
